metadata.description: Optional operator-only Stripe sandbox API probe; never run in CI. Requires separate restricted create/read/refund keys, Stripe CLI and ngrok; never skips when invoked.

options.command: test -n "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" && test -n "$STRIPE_READ_SECRET_KEY" && test -n "$STRIPE_REFUND_SECRET_KEY" && test -n "$STRIPE_ACCOUNT_ID" && test -n "$STRIPE_PRICE_ID_PRO_MONTHLY" && test -n "$STRIPE_PRODUCT_ID_CREDIT_PACK" && BILLING_STRIPE_ACCEPTANCE=true vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/testing/billing-stripe.acceptance.test.ts

metadata.description: Run one B8.3 local capacity profile on a disposable PostgreSQL 17 cluster it creates and destroys itself; never touches the developer database. Reports land under docs/research/artifacts/tau-cloud-credit-billing-launch-charter/runs/implementation/chunks/C09/lanes/i3/, raw logs under out/research/. Append `-- --runtime=native --postgres-bin=…` for a PostgreSQL 17 keg; the default compose runtime needs a local postgres:17-alpine image.
